description:
The technology stack includes Scala, Scalaz, Finagle, LMAX Disruptor, OpenHFT Chronicle, Elasticsearch, Spark, Redis, Ansible, and Docker. You will use your expertise to recommend the best open source tools for projects and open source your efforts. 

 You must have:
 Enthusiasm about learning and sharing knowledge in a team-oriented, startup environment 

 A mindset that software development is a craft
 An eye for typed functional programming
 A passion and a discipline for writing great software
 A desire to collaborate with team members to address the challenges of the programmatic ad tech space
 
 Requirements:
 Expertise with at least two JVM languages (such as Scala, Java, Clojure, etc.) 

 A background in building high-performance, distributed systems 

 Experience with ETL and machine learning ("big data" and analytics) 

 Front-end development with JavaScript and modern JS libraries 

 BS/MS in Computer Science 

 Must have verification 
 
 

 Contact: Karen Spaeder
